subject: How did Nanami's fight against Mahito end?

beats.title: Plot Details
beats.text: Mahito surmises that Nanami restricts his energy based on time. The jujutsu sorcerer begins divulging how his cursed technique works and runs toward the wall. Mahito chases him but Nanami knows that he can't fight this curse until he runs out of energy. Instead, Nanami must end the fight in one blow.

beats.title: Synopsis / Vs. Mahito Arc
beats.text: Nanami heads into the sewers where he comes in contact with Mahito.(Chapter 21, Episode 10) Nanami begins to fight against Mahito and plans to finish the fight quickly since he doesn't like to work overtime. Because Nanami manages to break Mahito's arm, Mahito stops fighting to explain how his technique works and heals his arm. As Mahito wonders what would happen if he uses his technique on a sorcerer, Nanami simply looks at his watch and says that he will finish this by six.(Chapter 22, Episode 10) Nanami continues to fight Mahito, which results in Mahito injuring Nanami.(Chapter 22, Episode 10) Once it hits 6 o'clock, Nanami wraps his tie around his hand(Episode 10) and starts to explain how his technique works. Nanami then uses his technique on a wall so that a large amount of rubble falls on top of them. As Mahito watches the rubble, Nanami uses his technique on him to injure his leg and retreats.(Chapter 23, Episode 10) Afterwards, Nanami contacts Kiyotaka Ijichi and reveals what had happened. After hanging up, Nanami thinks about what kind of character he is.(Chapter 24, Episode 11)(Episode 11) Later, Yuji finds out what happened to Nanami and asks Nanami to take him next time, Nanami explains how its not necessary and asks Yuji to continue observing Junpei.(Chapter 25, Episode 11)

beats.title: Plot Details
beats.text: In his last moments, Nanami smiles at his protégé and tells him that he's got it from here. Mahito promptly kills Nanami by totally destroying the top half of his body, shocking Yuji. Enraged in the next moment, Yuji screams and demands to know what Mahito is, rushing at him to fight. Further entertained, Mahito tells his adversary he can hear just fine without the yelling, preparing for their fated rematch.

beats.title: Synopsis / Vs. Mahito Arc
beats.text:
Nanami along with Yuji investigate the theater incident(Episode 8), where Nanami manages to teach Yuji to see remnants. As they follow the remnants, Nanami and Yuji talk about how there might be a witness to the murder.(Chapter 19, Episode 9) After following the remnants, the two come across two cursed spirits and each take one to face off against.(Chapter 19, Episode 9) Nanami begins to explain how his technique works and shows Yuji how it works. Nanami then watches Yuji and figures out how Yuji's technique works. Nanami notices that there is something wrong with the cursed spirits and stops Yuji from killing his spirit.(Chapter 20, Episode 9) Nanami has the cursed spirits examined, which Shoko Ieiri reveals that the cursed spirits were once humans. After learning of this, the two head out to continue investigating.(Chapter 20, Episode 9) After finding out that there have been multiple missing persons and mysterious deaths, Nanami decides to have Yuji investigate Junpei Yoshino while he follows up a different lead.(Chapter 21, Episode 10)(Episode 9)

Nanami heads into the sewers where he comes in contact with Mahito.(Chapter 21, Episode 10) Nanami begins to fight against Mahito and plans to finish the fight quickly since he doesn't like to work overtime. Because Nanami manages to break Mahito's arm, Mahito stops fighting to explain how his technique works and heals his arm. As Mahito wonders what would happen if he uses his technique on a sorcerer, Nanami simply looks at his watch and says that he will finish this by six.(Chapter 22, Episode 10) Nanami continues to fight Mahito, which results in Mahito injuring Nanami.(Chapter 22, Episode 10) Once it hits 6 o'clock, Nanami wraps his tie around his hand(Episode 10) and starts to explain how his technique works. Nanami then uses his technique on a wall so that a large amount of rubble falls on top of them. As Mahito watches the rubble, Nanami uses his technique on him to injure his leg and retreats.(Chapter 23, Episode 10) Afterwards, Nanami contacts Kiyotaka Ijichi and reveals what had happened. After hanging up, Nanami thinks about what kind of character he is.(Chapter 24, Episode 11)(Episode 11) Later, Yuji finds out what happened to Nanami and asks Nanami to take him next time, Nanami explains how its not necessary and asks Yuji to continue observing Junpei.(Chapter 25, Episode 11)

The next day, Nanami is handling Mahito's cursed spirits in the sewer with Takuma Ino. Nanami contacts Yuji about not heading to Junpei's school, Nanami then leaves Ino to handle the creatures as he thinks that Yuji will most likely head to the school anyway.(Chapter 26, Episode 12) Nanami manages to show up and defends Yuji, when Mahito was about to land a blow on Yuji.(Chapter 28, Episode 12) Nanami asks about the situation and Yuji reveals everything that had happened. After finding out that Yuji can harm Mahito, Nanami has Yuji fight Mahito with him. As Nanami and Yuji battle against Mahito, Mahito decides to change tactics and have cursed spirits attack Yuji.(Chapter 29, Episode 12) Nanami fights against Mahito, but Mahito manages to restrain Nanami. As Mahito goes to finish Nanami off, Yuji shows up and frees Nanami.(Chapter 29, Episode 12)

Nanami and Yuji continue to overwhelm Mahito, until Mahito uses his Self-Embodiment of Perfection to trap Nanami.(Chapter 29, Episode 12) Nanami thinks about the situation he is in and comes to the conclusion that he is in the palm of Mahito's hand.(Chapter 30, Episode 13) Nanami prepares to take on Mahito since he has no regrets but Yuji shows up and Sukuna wounds Mahito causing the Domain Expansion to be undone.(Chapter 30, Episode 13) Yuji tries to finish Mahito off but Mahito manages to get away. As Nanami makes plans to cut off Mahito's escape route, he notices that Yuji is laying on the ground and goes to check up on him.(Chapter 31, Episode 13)

Later that day, Nanami meets with Yuji and they talk about the situation that happened that day.(Chapter 31, Episode 13)

beats.title: Abilities and Powers / Overview
beats.text:
Overall Skill Level: Nanami is a model example of what a grade 1 jujutsu sorcerer should be. Yuji and Takuma Ino both look up to Nanami for his demeanor when actively approaching a difficult situation as well as his incredible skill when it comes down to solving it. Satoru Gojo entrusted Nanami with looking after Yuji due to these traits as well(Chapter 19, Episode 9) and it paid off well for Yuji's growth.(Chapter 31, Episode 13) Ino, a powerful grade 2 sorcerer, approaches every tough decision with "what would Nanami do" in mind because he believes Nanami always handles things the right way.(Chapter 95, Episode 35)

When it comes to combat ability, Nanami is capable of fighting on par with special grade cursed spirits such as Mahito. While Mahito was still in the infancy of his existence, Nanami was able to keep up in several of the exchanges. With a lack of information on Mahito's ability, Nanami suffered a direct blow to his soul but was still able to survive, something no one Mahito faced before had been able to do. Mahito himself considered Nanami to be exceptionally strong and a worthy opponent, far stronger than the average sorcerer.(Chapter 23, Episode 10)

During the Shibuya Incident, Nanami showcased his leadership ability alongside great intellect and fighting strength. Upon learning about Satoru's sealing, Nanami was able to deduce what would be the best move for his team and helped carry out Mechamaru's rescue plan without delay. Understanding that Kiyotaka Ijichi and the managers are crucial for communication in a large-scale mission, Nanami went alone to put protocols for the operation in place while also delegating the others on another task.(Chapter 93, Episode 34)

Following finding Ijichi injured, Nanami was quickly able to track down the culprit, Haruta Shigemo, and beat the curse user senseless without so much as suffering a scratch. This performance in particular was stunning to Nobara Kugisaki, a very capable grade 3 student. Watching Nanami fight helped her understand that he's on a completely different level and that embodies what it means to be a true grade 1 jujutsu sorcerer.(Chapter 100, Episode 36)

Alongside Naobito and Maki Zenin, Nanami was also able to fight the special grade curse Dagon. They were able to overpower him mostly thanks to Naobito's incredible speed backed up by Nanami's support. However, not even the two grade 1 sorcerers were able to exorcise him.(Chapter 107, Episode 38)

Trapped inside Dagon's Domain, Nanami was unable to take any offensive position whatsoever. However, he miraculously survived Dagon's endless stream of Death Swarm shikigami for over a minute, something that surprised him the domain's caster. Once Megumi arrived and nullified Dagon's automatic hit with his own domain, Nanami focused on protecting Megumi and was easily able to dispatch any shikigami that tried to attack the student despite his injuries.(Chapter 109, Episode 38) Despite being heavily injured by Dagon and later burned by Jogo, Nanami massacred an entire swarm of transfigured humans attempting to kill him.

beats.title: Abilities and Powers / Overview
beats.text:
Overall Skill Level: Mahito is an unregistered special grade cursed spirit that eclipses the power of at least three of Sukuna's fingers at the time of his first encounter with Yuji Itadori, and only continues to grow stronger.(Chapter 116, Episode 40) He is younger than Jogo and as a result, is less experienced and not as powerful at first. Despite this, Mahito is far above what a special grade cursed spirit would normally be and demonstrates rapid growth over the course of only two months. He has very high intelligence and an extremely dangerous cursed technique. Mahito has incredible development potential, as on multiple instances he has developed in the middle of battle.

In a one on one fight, he was able to overwhelm the grade 1 sorcerer, Kento Nanami, by rendering his cursed technique useless. Following that fight, Nanami believed that Mahito had to be exorcised immediately or else he would grow into something too fearsome for Jujutsu High to handle.

In Mahito's two on one battle with Nanami and Yuji, Mahito would have likely defeated both jujutsu sorcerers if it were not for Sukuna's intervention. During this fight, Mahito was able to grow stronger while his life was in danger, allowing him to conjure his own Domain Expansion.

Later, during the Shibuya Incident, Mahito went further beyond his boundaries, being able to create clones of himself that were indistinguishable from the original, while also developing his soul-manipulating abilities. Even after splitting his cursed energy in order to create a double, the divided Mahito still demonstrated relativity to Yuji in combat. During his fight with Yuji and later, Aoi Todo, he managed to land a Black Flash on the two of them, allowing him to gain sufficient understanding of cursed energy and his own soul to activate Instant Spirit Body of Distorted Killing, further increasing his power.

beats.title: Synopsis / Vs. Mahito Arc
beats.text: The two then have a brief chat about Yuji's condition and how Yuji is able to harm Mahito. Yuji and Nanami continue to fight Mahito: Mahito has Yuji fight his mutated humans while he takes on Nanami. As Mahito manages to restrain Nanami, Yuji shows up and frees Nanami. Yuji and Nanami then overwhelm Mahito, which forces Mahito to trap Nanami in his Domain Expansion. Yuji manages to break in, which causes Mahito to touch Sukuna's soul, resulting in Mahito being wounded.
